# Copilot instructions — Pizza Ontology

This repo's primary agent setup is Claude Code (see `/CLAUDE.md` and `.claude/agents/`). This file exists so GitHub Copilot's coding agent follows the same domain rules if it's used here instead — the two are meant to give equivalent results, just without Claude's subagent dispatch (Copilot should do the curator/importer/ontologist steps itself, in order, within one session).

## Domain rules (same as CLAUDE.md)

- The editable file is `src/ontology/pizza-edit.owl`. Never hand-edit anything under `src/ontology/imports/` — those are generated by `make imports/foodon_import.owl -B` from `src/ontology/iri_dependencies/foodon_import.txt`.
- New terms authored here use temporary IDs in the `PIZZA_099xxxx` range. A human/automation step allocates the permanent ID after merge — see `.github/workflows/allocate-definitive-ids.yml`.
- Before authoring a new topping/ingredient class, check whether it already exists in [FoodOn](https://foodon.org/) (via OLS: `https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/api/search?q=<label>&ontology=foodon`). If it does, import it rather than duplicating it.
- Named pizzas must carry explicit `hasTopping`/`hasBase` restrictions for everything the issue describes — not just a label.
- Always run `make normalize_src` then `robot reason -i pizza-edit.owl -r ELK` from `src/ontology` before opening a PR, and report the actual output.
- Sign authored terms with `<obo:IAO_0000117>AI agent</obo:IAO_0000117>`.
- Always work on a branch named `issue-N`, reference the issue number in the PR, never commit directly to `main`.

For the full reasoning behind each rule, see `CLAUDE.md` — this file is intentionally a condensed mirror of it.
